ui.pmg_PANEL_6: Thermal image (if available)｜no abnormal hot spots

soon.finReports: Monthly, quarterly, half-year and annual reports: revenue, cost and margin by business type, receivables, payables, cash flow — from the orders, invoices, receipts and payments already on file.
soon.expenses: Staff expense claims: photograph the receipt, AI reads amount, date and category, the manager approves, finance pays and books it.
soon.training: The T of iMROT: courses, competence assessment, and teaching cases taken from real repairs; each person's record goes into their talent-pool file.
soon.permissions: Who may see and do what by role (including what the AI may do on their behalf). Today the rules follow the role in the employee file.
soon.dictionary: All codes and option lists in one place: brands, equipment categories, units, business types, document prefixes. Brands and series are kept under Product series for now.
soon.payroll: Monthly payroll computed automatically: pay terms, the month's overtime and the performance result give gross pay; social security (SSO) and withholding tax (PND1) are deducted; the MD approves; payslips and filing summaries follow. Pay terms are in the employee files and overtime under Overtime for now.
